description: Legal Affairs Department - Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance (Chapter 420)
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the President under the Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance, specifically authorizing the issuance of Treasury Bonds for loan restructuring. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for financial instruments and debt management, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
